verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents image inputs for vision-capable models [cerebras-docs-27] and supports the standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape with base64 data URIs [cerebras-docs-15], so vision calls work on the same API as text chat. Nothing in the pack shows audio models (speech-to-text or text-to-speech) or image-generation endpoints, so the platform covers only one of the three modalities in the story. Missing for 10: audio model support, image-generation models, and a documented list of which models are vision-capable, plus independent hands-on corroboration of vision use.
